images.madeBy: Alex Smith, for this bestax port
images.method: Drawn by code: docs/scripts/template-art/scenes/hotel.mjs places every block and shape, and the voxel renderer in docs/scripts/template-art writes the SVG, with every texture generated from a palette and a seed. No photograph, stock image or other third-party image was used as an input or as a tracing reference.
images.depicts: A blocky hotel by day: a terracotta tower on the corner of two long wings that wrap a courtyard pool, with loungers, striped parasols and palms under a pale banded sky; the background of the full-height welcome.
images.replaces: public/media/background.webp, the original's photo of a pool behind the welcome, whose source the original does not record.
